skill.description: Comprehensive PDF toolkit for extracting text and tables, creating and modifying PDFs, merging and splitting files, and filling forms with helper scripts.
skill.summary: Process, inspect, convert, and fill PDF documents with practical Python, JavaScript, and command-line workflows.

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, JavaScript template literals, source comments, and documented PDF examples. Three confirmed issues remain: helper scripts write to caller-supplied output paths without overwrite protection, which can replace writable files if invoked with an unsafe path. I found no prompt injection attempt, hidden network calls, or data exfiltration intent.

remediation.issue: Helper scripts can overwrite caller-supplied output files.
remediation.suggestion: Check whether the output path already exists and require an explicit overwrite flag, or write to a new filename by default.

remediation.issue: Command examples rely on local PDF tooling and third-party parsers.
remediation.suggestion: Tell users to run commands only on trusted documents or inside a workspace, and keep dependencies updated.

remediation.issue: Form workflows create intermediate files that may contain personal data.
remediation.suggestion: Document cleanup steps and recommend storing intermediate files in a dedicated working directory.

content.user_title: Process PDFs with Extraction and Form Tools
content.value_statement: PDF work often requires switching between extraction, conversion, form filling, and command-line tools. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code practical workflows and scripts for common PDF tasks.
actual_capabilities: Extract text and tables from PDFs with pypdf, pdfplumber, and PDF.js examples.
Merge, split, rotate, crop, watermark, and encrypt PDF files with documented workflows.
Create new PDFs with reportlab and pdf-lib examples.
Convert PDF pages to images for visual review and OCR workflows.
Inspect fillable PDF fields and generate field metadata with included scripts.
Fill PDF forms through native fields or text annotations with validation helpers.
limitations: Requires local Python packages, command-line tools, or JavaScript libraries for many workflows.
Scanned documents need OCR, and accuracy depends on image quality.
Non-fillable form workflows require careful manual inspection of generated validation images.
Helper scripts create local output files and may overwrite existing files with the same path.

use_cases.title: Prepare Office Documents
use_cases.description: Merge, split, rotate, and watermark PDF files for routine document preparation.

use_cases.title: Extract Structured Content
use_cases.description: Pull text and tables from reports, then save results for analysis in other tools.

use_cases.title: Complete PDF Forms
use_cases.description: Inspect form fields, map user data to fields, and generate a completed PDF.

prompt_templates.title: Extract PDF Text
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract the text from this PDF and summarize the main sections. Save the full extracted text as a separate text file.

prompt_templates.title: Merge and Reorder Pages
prompt_templates.prompt: Merge these PDF files in order, remove blank pages if any are obvious, and create one final document with a clear filename.

prompt_templates.title: Fill a Simple Form
prompt_templates.prompt: Check whether this PDF has fillable fields. Fill it with the provided user details and show me any fields that need manual review.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Complex Form Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert this non-fillable PDF to images, identify each entry area, create validation images, and iterate until the filled form is accurate.

output_examples.input: A user asks to extract tables from a quarterly report PDF.
output_examples.output: The skill identifies table pages, extracts the rows, and reports which tables may need manual cleanup.

output_examples.input: A user provides three PDF files and asks for one ordered packet.
output_examples.output: The skill merges the files, names the final packet, and notes any page handling decisions.

output_examples.input: A user provides a non-fillable application form and applicant details.
output_examples.output: The skill creates page images, validates entry boxes, and produces a filled PDF for review.

best_practices: Work in a dedicated folder so generated PDFs, images, and field files are easy to review.
Check output files before sharing them, especially when filling forms with personal data.
Use validation images for non-fillable forms before adding final annotations to the PDF.
anti_patterns: Do not run PDF commands on untrusted files outside a controlled workspace.
Do not reuse an existing output filename unless overwriting it is intentional.
Do not skip visual validation when adding text to non-fillable forms.

faq.question: Can this skill fill PDF forms?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports fillable PDF fields and annotation-based filling for non-fillable forms.

faq.question: Does it work with scanned PDFs?
faq.answer: Yes, but scanned PDFs require image conversion and OCR. Results depend on scan quality.

faq.question: Which tools does it use?
faq.answer: It documents pypdf, pdfplumber, reportlab, pdf-lib, PDF.js, qpdf, pdftotext, and related PDF utilities.

faq.question: Can it extract tables?
faq.answer: Yes. The guide includes pdfplumber workflows for extracting tables and combining them for analysis.

faq.question: Will it send documents to the internet?
faq.answer: No network upload behavior was found. The included scripts operate on local files.

faq.question: What should users review before publishing output?
faq.answer: Users should verify filled fields, page order, extracted text accuracy, and any personal data in intermediate files.
